description: This file defines the AccrualPeriodData class, which models an accrual period in a loan accounting context. It contains properties related to interest accrual, charges, fees, and penalties, along with methods to aggregate charge amounts and accrued values.

classes.name: AccrualPeriodData
classes.description: A data container representing an accrual period for a loan, including dates, interest, and associated charges.

methods.name: addCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to the accrual period's list of charges.

methods.name: getChargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of all charges, summing their charge amounts.

methods.name: getFeeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total fee amount, filtering out penalty charges.

methods.name: getFeeAccrued
methods.description: Calculates total accrued fee charges, filtering out penalty charges.

methods.name: getFeeAccruable
methods.description: Calculates total fee charges that are accruable, filtering out penalty charges.

methods.name: getPenaltyAccruable
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charges that are accruable.
